claim: The chapter glosses 〜さま and its kanji spelling 様 ("Mr./Ms."), but neither form has a card anywhere in the collection.
evidence: Book, postcard vocabulary: "〜さま Mr./Ms. (used in letter writing)"; Japanese addresses note: "(8) 様" = "Mr./Ms." (ruby さま). candidates/coverage.json lists 様 and notes that さま and 様 should merge to the kanji form; reading-report.json instead drops the kana さま to the kana pool, and the kana deck (chapter-26) did not choose it. No cards.json in the collection has 様 or さま.
fix: Add a word card 様 (reading さま, "Mr./Ms. (in letters)") to this unit, with a character-gap card for 様 if the pipeline needs one.

claim: This chapter teaches 三日 (みっか) as the 3rd of the month, but the only 三日 card, from RW4, answers only "Three days", so the date sense is carded nowhere.
evidence: Book, Kanji Practice C: "3. 三日" matched to "(h) みっか" in the 一日 to 二十日 date series; RW4 kanji table: "三日(みっか) three days". Card chapter-17 r-482dccb7367c: 三日 "Three days". This unit's other dates read "The 2nd (day of the month)", "The 4th (day of the month)" and so on; reading-report.json drops 三日 here as already carded in Chapter 18.
fix: Give r-482dccb7367c both senses, e.g. "The 3rd (day of the month); three days".

claim: The table teaches 今 (いま, now) and 山 (やま, mountain) as words with one reading each, but both ship only as silent character cards from earlier units, while 私 and 川, taught the same way, are voiced word cards.
evidence: Book: "今(いま) now", "山(やま) mountain". Cards: chapter-4 r-d2130d70a08e 今 "Now" (kon, kin / ima, no audio); chapter-5 r-0e248e5603d3 山 "Mountain" (san / yama, no audio). This unit's as-generated.json had 今 as a word (ttsText いま) under the same id, and chapter-12's had 山 as a word (ttsText やま). chapter-18 r-4bbe59fd177f 私 (watashi) and chapter-12 r-0f6a7e280c00 川 (kawa) carry audio.
fix: Make 今 and 山 voiced word cards (いま, やま), as card rule 4 asks for a kanji the book also teaches as a word.

claim: The English "Take care." keeps a trailing full stop that 28 of the collection's 30 greeting cards do not have.
evidence: Book: "では、お元気で Take care." Card: では、お元気で "Take care.". Other greetings read like "Good morning" with no stop; the only other one with a stop is chapter-13 お大事に "Get well soon.".
